description: SendMyVoice turns voice notes into structured data — automatically. Record a voice note, AI transcribes and organizes it, then delivers the result to Notion, Google Docs, Google Sheets, or Email. No typing, no forms. How it works: Set up a workflow, hit record, speak naturally. AI extracts key details (amounts, dates, names, action items) and sends structured data to your chosen destination.
